# PII detection fixtures - NEGATIVE near-miss cases
#
# Format:  <question text>
#
# One case per line. These MUST NOT trip any detector.
#
# This file is the reason the brief's phrase "regex + checksum validation" is not
# enough on its own. Every line here is an ordinary question a user would ask this
# assistant, and a regex that matches a bare 4-6 digit run or an unanchored
# identifier shape will flag it. The detector rules in pii.py are shaped by these
# lines as much as by the positive file - in particular DETECT_BARE_OTP_NUMBERS
# exists because of lines like the holdings row and the "500000" goal.
#
# Blank lines and lines starting with '#' are ignored.
